sentences.text:
, on 19 March, 2020
 1
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice A.V.Sesha Sai

1. This is an application, filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, by the petitioner, seeking quashment of F.I.R. No.409 of 2019 of Mangalagiri Rural police station, Guntur District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act,2006.
2.

entities.text: Mangalagiri Rural police station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is brought to the notice of this Court by the learned counsel for petitioner so also the learned Additional Public Prosecutor that the issue in the present Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the earlier Order of this Court, dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018.

3. Having regard to the said Order and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal petition is also allowed in terms thereof, quashing the proceedings in F.I.R.No.409 of 2019 of Mangalagiri Rural police station, Guntur District.
4.

entities.text: Mangalagiri Rural police station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Office to enclose a copy of the Order, dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any in the Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
